result.note: Mostly speculation about shelving sales. Tested only the confirmed collapse of the IDBI Bank sale and the stalled status of the SCI and HLL Lifecare sales.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the Union government's privatisation programme as of March 2026:
items: The strategic sale of IDBI Bank collapsed after bids failed to meet the government's minimum price.
The privatisation of Shipping Corporation of India and HLL Lifecare was completed in 2020-21.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong. The SCI and HLL Lifecare sales were not completed and have been stuck in limbo since 2020-21. Beyond the sale of Air India to Tata, the drive announced in 2021 has been held back by red tape, high reserve prices and unresolved liabilities such as pension dues.
questions.source: The IDBI deal collapsed last week after bids failed to meet the government’s minimum price, while SCI and HLL have been trapped in limbo since 2020-21.
